_doc: Mobile-only UI strings that are not (yet) in packages/shared-schemas/i18n. Keys must be identical in mobile.ar.json and mobile.en.json and must not collide with shared keys. tool/gen_arb.dart merges both sources into lib/l10n/*.arb.

about.quranText: Quran text: The Noble Qur'an Encyclopedia (quranenc.com) Uthmani text, Hafs an Asim, via quran-json 3.1.2 — CC BY 4.0. Bundled unchanged; verified by SHA-256.
about.translation: English translation: Saheeh International, via quran-json 3.1.2 (licence review pending).
about.pages: Mushaf page boundaries: Madinah Mushaf 1405H (KFGQPC) via QuranMeHelp manifest — Waqf General Public License 2.0.
about.fonts: Fonts: Amiri Quran and IBM Plex Sans Arabic — SIL Open Font License 1.1.
about.prayerAlgo: Prayer times are calculated on the device with standard astronomical formulas (Meeus / USNO) and checked against the independent adhan-js library.
about.tzdb: Time zones: IANA tz database (public domain) via the timezone package.
about.openSource: Open source and free forever. No tracking, no ads, no in-app purchases.
